name: source_timestamp
description: Timestamp supplied by the vehicle telemetry record.

name: ingested_at
description: Timestamp at which the platform received the record.

name: vin
description: Vehicle VIN when present; never used to guess ownership.

name: record_type
description: Decoded telemetry record or message type.

name: telemetry_config_version
description: Telemetry configuration version or hash when available.

name: transport_message_id
description: Transport identifier retained for delivery diagnostics.

name: telemetry_client_version
description: Vehicle telemetry client version when available.

name: quarantine_reason
description: Reason trusted ownership routing could not complete.
